verdict.rationale: Khoj documents offline AI chat models and self-hosting on your own hardware without sharing data off-device, plus a dedicated Ollama guide using its local OpenAI-compatible server. The GitHub README says it can chat with any local LLM, and community reports confirm search runs fully offline. Older HN comments said chat required OpenAI, but they describe an earlier state when open-source LLMs were still being 'experimented with', so they lower confidence rather than contradict current docs. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of llama.cpp, LM Studio and vLLM backends, and independent hands-on confirmation that chat runs fully offline on local models.
